name: SIQ - BA Morph Cards
description: A responsive grid of before/after cards with a stunning circular morph reveal animation. Click or tap anywhere on a card to trigger an expanding ripple that reveals the 'after' state. Each card has an optional persistent toggle, label, badge, and CTA. 3 reveal modes (ripple, slide, fade), configurable grid columns, card sizes desktop & mobile, all gaps and paddings — fully customizable for beauty, fitness, and lifestyle brands.
author: SectionIQ
